archetypes.name: nested-claude-auth
archetypes.rationale: Checks that the code-flow lane reuses the shared Claude auth classifier without duplicating fragile auth logic.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the nested Claude subprocess path for Step 7a. Focus on timeout behavior, auth classification, sidecar parsing, and warning text stability. Verify the change does not add another polling loop or make the best-effort diagram lane fatal. Cite each finding with the relevant file path and line number. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
